In the Field

Rockhound Explorer Lapidary Artist

The work starts outside—creeks, roadcuts, volcanic country, and the geology underfoot. Always looking down, because that is where the story begins.

A huge part of why I enjoy this hobby so much is the geological knowledge I get to apply. And sharing that knowledge with people means more to me than money.
